spec.claim_summary: Base long entry when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 with DCA averaging ladder and 3% take-profit above average entry and no stop loss.
assumptions: Asset not named in claim text; ETHUSDT chosen as most natural reading from page context.
Direction inferred as long: averaging down at lower prices and take-profit above average entry implies long position.
Closest testable core is single base entry with 3% fixed target from entry and no stop; no exit condition besides target.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging/DCA entry legs at fixed deviations (-2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25%) with 1.8x size scaling per rung were omitted; spec tests only single base entry when RSI crosses below 28.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take-profit basis is 3% above average/blended entry of the whole ladder; spec implements 3% above base entry because ladder average cannot be expressed, changing exit price and verdict.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Stop Loss None - ladder allocation is the structural risk cap; no stop-loss field set.

audit_majors: entry: Omits the five averaging/DCA legs at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% with 1.8x size scaling per rung; spec tests only the single base RSI entry.
take_profit_pct: Claim requires 3% above average/blended entry of the whole ladder; spec implements 3% above base entry, changing exit price whenever any averaging order fills.
